name: Smart inbox: only what needs you
author: wizard
description: Chats › Inbox holds only what can't go on without you: a needs-you that blocks, an approval, a failed run (with one line saying why) and what you asked for: answers, reports, summaries and lookups (also when you asked without a question mark), plus deliveries you set up (scheduled runs, reminders, the Daily brief, a thread you pinned like Topics). Everything else finishes in Sent, whoever started it: done, FYI and check-this asks, watches and helper results that only confirm, a new chat's first message. Running chats are in Sent › Working. Unread alone never puts a chat in Inbox, and a chat is never in both. Your agents keep needs-you for real blockers, and their check-this asks wait in the agent inbox for catch me up.
